narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Ten litres is ten mugs, so it takes one hundred fifty seconds.
<bookmark mark='why'/>Eigh mug holds only half eigh litre, so ten litres is many more mugs.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>He mixed litres with millilitres, so that slip is wrong.
removed_beats.on_screen: Chintu's bubble shows 10 mugs × 15 s = 150 s; a mug beside a one litre jug shows the mug is half; the bubble is struck in the warning colour

narration: <bookmark mark='c1'/>To check, the bucket is twenty times the mug, so the time is twenty times too.
<bookmark mark='c2'/>Three hundred divided by sixty is five, so the answer is five minutes.
removed_beats.on_screen: the stage clears except the tap; two check lines appear: bucket = 20 mugs, time = 20 × 15 s; 300 ÷ 60 = 5

old_misconception.wrong_move: Chintu treats ten litres as ten mugs and says one hundred fifty seconds. A mug holds only half eigh litre, so the units do not match; the bubble is struck.
